theme: An open day with the girls, one call at noon, a week to Croatia.
greeting: Good morning, Dan. Almost the whole day is yours: a single governance call at midday, the girls in the house, and the Croatia countdown now inside a week.

needsAttention.title: Lock the PRI call with Conor Kehoe
needsAttention.detail: Conor's office sent a Zoom invite to continue the PRI conversation Eugenia Jackson introduced back in July; it is still unread, and his assistant Kate will hold a time once you confirm. Worth a same-day reply while you are between roles.

needsAttention.title: Pack the travel larder bin
needsAttention.detail: The Household task is a day overdue and the House 1 to House 2 move is Wednesday. Packing it now makes the first migration the test run while there is still time to fix what does not travel well.

needsAttention.title: Close the last Croatia bookings
needsAttention.detail: Two p1 travel items are still open: the single Sept 19 Cavtat night after the charter, and written confirmation that checked bags are actually on the Eurowings ticket. Both have to be settled from shore, before a week aboard with almost no connectivity.
